request.description: Emails a single-use confirmation link to your VASP profile's compliance_email. Opening the link and pressing its confirm button confirms the address, which the Didit network needs before it lists your profile. A new request replaces the previous link; the link stops working when the compliance email changes. One email per minute per address.

variable.description: (Required) Opaque session token returned when the widget session was minted.

request.description: Public read endpoint keyed by the widget session token - no API key required. Returns the widget context plus the status of every proof, so you can poll it to detect completion; completed_at becomes non-null once a proof is verified. A SATOSHI_TEST proof can sit at status PENDING while its deposit is seen on-chain but unconfirmed - a background job automatically rechecks it and completes it once the deposit confirms, so no client action is needed while it waits. Each proof carries the fields its method needs: deposit_address, expected_amount, and its own expires_at for SATOSHI_TEST; challenge for MESSAGE_SIGNING. Prefer the travel_rule.status.updated webhook over polling when the session is linked to a transfer.

response.name: The widget context and proof statuses.
Unknown token.
The session expired without completing.

variable.description: (Required) Didit-stable transaction UUID that owns the transfer (the beneficiary side's transaction).

request.description: Resolve a transfer that waits on wallet ownership: call it on your own side of the transfer when it is UNCONFIRMED_OWNERSHIP, or when it is an inbound transfer in ON_HOLD. Confirming marks the matching wallet address book entry as ownership-verified (for an inbound ON_HOLD transfer with no entry, Didit creates one from beneficiary_data.wallet_address) and runs the beneficiary name match on both sides of the transfer; denying declines both sides. An inbound transfer whose deposit already settled moves on to FINISHED when the match succeeds. For an inbound TRP transfer in UNCONFIRMED_OWNERSHIP, ON_HOLD or COUNTERPARTY_MISMATCHED_DATA, Didit sends your decision to the originating VASP instead: approving returns the payment address (wallet_address, or the matched entry's address) and moves the transfer to COMPLETED, and denying declines it.

response.name: The updated transfer. For an inbound transfer the counterparty's originator_data/beneficiary_data stay masked (`data_masked: true`) until ownership is confirmed, then `data_unmasked` records when, why and by whom.

item.name: Send a Travel Rule message or document request

variable.description: (Required) Didit-stable transaction UUID that owns the transfer.

request.description: Sends a message or a document request to the counterparty VASP. Works on INTERNAL transfers (the other Didit customer sees it on its side of the pair) and EMAIL transfers (the counterparty is emailed and answers in the pickup portal). A transfer over TRP, GTR, TRUST, VerifyVASP or Sygna carries no messages, because those protocols have none. Limits: 100 messages per transfer, 5000 characters per body, 10 requested documents, 5 files of 10 MB each.
